limits: Reports are retained samples, not a census of all failing endpoints.
Absent pins in top-path samples do not prove their absence in the netlist or electrical improvement.
Same printed pins across changed netlists do not prove functional equivalence.
Delay deltas are paired only when driver pin, sink pin, launch register and endpoint all match.
Printed-arc-only delay deltas are separately labelled exploratory; transition identity and netlist equivalence are unverified.
Delay improvements on separate arcs must not be added as predicted global WNS improvement.
Data arc reconstruction excludes clock paths; unavailable input pins are explicit parse limitations.
No checkpoint, constraint, project, CPU source, campaign code, service or running job is modified.
diagnostic_scope.note: 3110 sampled paths across36reports are not3110 distinct failing endpoints or a full1716endpoint census. Original census pipeline markers absent; later focused cohort proof is separate.

recipe_caveats: Named strategy changes may affect several implementation steps at once; isolated directives have separate evidence.
ML1/2/3 are native RQS strategies; do not conflate with Auto_1/2/3 placement.
Physical net aliases can identify another hierarchy than their actual driver; local_fma includedCASTdriver targets.
Final and routed stage metrics can differ. Keep both stage reports; compare selected_stage, not merely the filenamefinal.
Synthesis/pre-route estimates are not signoff; NO_LC/NoSharing estimated results did not predict routed outcome.
Historical seconds mix resumed stages, thread counts and checkpoint reuse; do not use them as comparable total flow durations.
150/300MHz user-reported measurements have no numeric verified provenance in this index; avoid inventing them.

Synthesis variants can change total setup endpoint population (e.g.NO_LC96439 vs gold96433). A sample of top100 paths is not a fixed-population comparison. Later focused night uses immutable96433/1439endpoint means.
